name: kpi-stat
title: KPI stat and row
description: A muted label, a title-size value in tabular mono numerals and an optional delta (up in success, down in destructive; an unchanged value shows none). `KpiRow` is the one surface that holds a row of stats.
docs: Example: <KpiStat label="Quotes made" value="17" trend={[14, 12, 15, 11, 13, 10, 9]} trendLabel="Steady over 7 days" />. `trend` draws a small line scaled to its own range; fewer than two readings draw nothing.
